about: Gaps already known in how Ibid reads the 2026 draft merger guidelines, each with the reason it is accepted for now. Written from the run of 2026-09-17, after the fixes that run prompted. See scripts/answer-key.mjs: anything not listed here fails the check, and so does anything listed that no longer happens.
